intro: Between April 12 and April 30, 2026, ZCyberNews covered 26 credential-theft incidents, with APT41, Bluekit, and CrystalX among the most active threat actors. The critical CVE-2026-33829 was consistently exploited across technology, cloud services, financial services, and software development sectors. The 18 high-severity and 6 critical reports highlighted global impacts, with Europe, North America, Bangladesh, and South Asia as key regions.
